title: Price signed dependent-source delivery over characteristic zero
body:
Binary correlated-update tariffs do not price signed characteristic-zero delivery. This adds only `research/signed-dependent-delivery/`: a written all-word query theorem, an exact integer-kernel optimizer, and a three-delivery dirty-connector construction for sources `x,x+u,x+2u`.

The signed balance `(1,-2,1)` removes **two whole completed source calls**: `6B+6A -> 4B+6A`, with every imposed source mutation and final source restoration retained. For positive sign-symmetric complete prices, the exact general bill is `2 sum a_i + min_{M^T t=0} sum b_i phi(t_i)`, where `phi(0)=2` and `phi(t)=abs(t)` otherwise. The proof permits arbitrary query multiplicities and strict per-request deliveries; it does not assume intermediate connector coherence.

The complete recursive comparison is conditional and explicit: if one source call has full child profile `nu_r`, the change is `-2 nu_r` before all noncommon controller, storage/lifetime, routing, hosting and precision charges. No selected caller, favorable complete supplier invoice, new root or kappa is claimed.

The expanded nine-port pilot is 32 versus 40 signed unit ADDs, including source return. Its maximum primitive-prefix row-L1 is 9 versus 8; literal inverses give 8 versus 9, so common bidirectional capacity needs 9 for either program. Opening the fixed maps gives a cheaper 14-ADD direct comparator. These facts explicitly limit the macro optimum and preclude an unrestricted circuit or physical-speedup claim.

Validation: registered CPython 3.12 replay and optimized CPython 3.14; 117 primary optimizer cases; 130 separately implemented unrestricted signed-query Dijkstra cases; all 81 endpoint coefficients per pilot and every delivery cut; 19,683 arbitrary dirty ternary-grid states and literal full inverses; 68 primary and five independent defect controls; optimized read-only Git-free replay and source/receipt corruptions. Every independent check remains active under `-O`. Written proof plus finite exact checks and separate AI mathematical review; no formal-kernel or independent human proof claim. Hosted checks remain separate.

Credit Adam Gall PR2060 (`3555161e4f292b49622ee05cfb3fbbb34ddfbf75`) for binary source dependence and the incoherent echo grammar; Ross Richardson PR1780/934/943, woklerx PR1439/1442, martinxxx9 PR1088 and their retained dirty-commutator/supplier lineage. No predecessor code is imported or modified. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including a separate mathematical specialist; Apache-2.0.

Base `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority 6; selected record unchanged. [Canonical scoped claim/finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1776#discussioncomment-18983463). Next step: identify one actual affine-source recursive caller and price its best fused comparator and complete physical admission; stop further toy expansion until then.
